healthProfile.title: Health & Dietary Profile
healthProfile.subtitle: Ensure your therapists and culinary masters tailor every session safely to your physical needs.
healthProfile.consentText: I explicitly consent to HeavenStay collecting and storing my health notes and dietary preferences solely for personalized therapeutic treatments and safe meal preparation during my retreat stay.
healthProfile.therapistNotice: This section is shared exclusively with certified therapists assigned to your treatment room.
healthProfile.medicalConditionsHint: e.g., lower back stiffness, mild hypertension, muscle tightness
healthProfile.mobilityHint: e.g., avoid intense spinal twists, gentle stretching preferred
healthProfile.chefNotice: This section is shared exclusively with the Executive Wellness Chef and F&B culinary crew.
healthProfile.allergiesHint: e.g., Peanuts, Crustaceans, Shellfish, Tree Nuts
healthProfile.deletionLinkText: Need to exercise your right to erasure? Request health data deletion.

deletion.title: Health Data Deletion Request
deletion.subtitle: Submit a formal request to purge your confidential wellness notes and dietary records from our systems.
deletion.policyAlert: Health data deletion cannot immediately occur while an active or upcoming retreat is in progress, as customer safety and treatment protocol require verified health notes during your stay.
deletion.activeRetreatWarning: Active / Upcoming Retreat Detected: Your deletion request will be registered and safely executed after your retreat check-out is complete.
deletion.eligibleNotice: No active retreats found. Your health records are eligible for immediate purge.
deletion.reasonPlaceholder: Please share why you wish to remove your health data...
deletion.confirmCheckbox: I understand that purging my health records will reset all therapist personalization and dietary safety profiles for future retreats.
